workload.scope: 32-command two-peer burst; observed prefix age, not a universal loss bound

limitations: Actual native WebSocket clients and workerd relay connected by a bounded loopback test bridge; this is not deployed WSS or Internet qualification.
Tendriller HTTP controls and peer routing ran in workerd with synthetic authenticated accounts; deployed login was not exercised.
Control HTTP is blocked independently of the relay. Ciphertext transit consumes measured host bandwidth and depends on relay availability.
